author: neuropolimer
name: AccessRoleCheck
short: Keeps a visual access role in sync with configured key roles.
description: Automatically grants a configured access role when a member has any configured key role, removes it when no key roles remain, handles join-time roles, reacts to later role changes, and can synchronize all existing members.
install_msg: Loaded `accessrolecheck`. Configure it with `[p]accessrole set @AccessRole`, add key roles with `[p]accessrole addkey @KeyRole`, then use `[p]accessrole sync` if needed. Existing members are also synchronized automatically when the configuration changes and on bot startup.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store end-user data. It only stores guild configuration containing role IDs.
